value.title: A collection of nouns and verbs for tiered partner compute routing, Modal QLoRA and sandbox verification, Baseten 2M TPM swarms and Fireworks multi-LoRA rubric checks

Schedule parallel worker claims under <= 2,000,000 TPM sliding-window pacing with pre-flight fencing-token and lease-TTL gates.
Select a specialist LoRA drafter behind a sub-2ms edge shim and verify structured JSON outputs with a distinct rubric-verifier adapter.
